name: battle-royale
description: Battle Royale: The Science-Backed Fight Simulator

scripts.setup: npm ci && uv sync --directory backend && npm ci --prefix frontend && git config core.hooksPath .githooks
scripts.start: npm run build && node -e "console.log('\nBattle Royale is starting at http://localhost:8000\n')" && uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:scripts
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.format: uv run --directory backend ruff check --fix --select I . && uv run --directory backend ruff format . && npm run format --prefix frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_schema.py && uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm run gen:api --prefix frontend
